question: Is there any update on PROJ-318?

systems.stop_reason: single-pass, one follow-up hop + question-ID exact match

answers.flat-RAG:
Yes — there's an update on PROJ-318 (Investigate carrier API rate limiting on shipping label generation), tied to INC1130.

Per the ticket comments from Diego Alvarez:
- The 429 rate-limit errors track tightly with peak-hour order volume.
- The team is weighing two options: implementing client-side backoff vs. requesting a higher rate limit from the carrier — the latter has a longer lead time.
- No fix has been merged yet; the approach is still being decided.

This matches the linked incident INC1130, whose current status confirms the same: 429s correlate with peak order volume, and the team is still deciding between client-side backoff and requesting a higher carrier limit, with no fix merged yet.

So the update is: root cause understood (carrier rate limiting during peak volume), but resolution approach is still undecided and no fix has shipped.
